column1: # veraPDF corpus files whose verdict this repository does not yet match, each with its reason.
# "miss": a rule the checker does not have (the file passes though it should fail), named by the
# clause folder the corpus files it under. "stricter": a check deliberately stricter than veraPDF.
# "deep": a PDF/UA-1 rule the deep checker owns (CLAUDE.md, "Which side owns which PDF/UA check"),
# so PdfUaChecker alone passes the file; the code after the colon is the error PdfAccessibility.Audit
# reports for it, which Accessibility's UaConformanceCorpusTests asserts.
# The list only shrinks: ConformanceCorpusTests fails an entry whose file now gets its verdict.
